d: Long, flowing jet black hair with blunt-cut bangs and a side parting frames a youthful, mature face with sharp, bright azure eyes. The slender build is dressed in a dark forest green sleeveless top with a high collar, paired with matching dark green shorts and brown thigh-high stockings that transition into dark grey heeled boots. A wide dark brown utility belt with several pouches and straps encircles the waist, complemented by dark brown fingerless gloves. The figure is equipped with two oversized, silver metallic jagged blades.
